description: Points a firm's own domain at its FinishTax website: the root of the domain and www.
variableDescription: address: the IPv4 address of FinishTax's hosting platform for this website. target: the hosting platform's host name that www points to. verify1, verify2: one-time values that prove the domain belongs to the firm; each is the part after vc-domain-verify= and is applied only when the hosting platform asks for it. Every request is signed, so no value can be changed on the way.
